revisions.originalPrompt:
Create a final production illustration atlas for an original premium fantasy trading card game. EXACTLY 24 separate SQUARE paintings in an EXACT 6 columns × 4 rows edge-to-edge grid. Output a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536×1024 pixels or larger; exactly six columns and four rows. All cells exactly equal in width and height. NO gutters, NO outer margins, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO card UI, NO numbers. Every creature and scene must stay entirely inside its own square with a 6% safe inset around the subject. No cross-cell elements.

VISUAL DIRECTION: richly hand-inked 2D Japanese fantasy TCG illustration. Sophisticated organic anatomy, expressive curved silhouettes, fine ink contours, sculpted cel-shadows, luminous gouache color, ornamental gold linework, intricate layered feathers/fur/scales drawn as shapes, deep jeweled colors and ivory highlights. Every cell is a complete cinematic illustration with a substantial creature or event dominating an individually painted environment. Illustrated, not photographic, not realistic3D, not flat vector geometry, not an icon, not an emblem. Unified elegant painting style across every cell. Each painting has a different pose, camera angle and composition as directed.

The subjects below correspond to catalogue cards, but NEVER PRINT their names or identifiers. Paint precisely in reading order:
ROW 1, left to right: CELL 1: several falling stars converging into a great luminous tide, happening in a copper and jade forge carved into living stone; rear three-quarter view with visible expressive face; a wide sweeping crescent. Tiny ivory star-antlered stag figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, starlit azure.
CELL 2: several falling stars converging into a great luminous tide, happening in a ruined ivory observatory above an ocean of stars; close dynamic view with the entire main silhouette inside the tile; a wide sweeping crescent. Tiny sleek turquoise river fox with flowing multiple tails figures establish scale and story. Palette: ivory/gold, turquoise and sapphire.
CELL 3: several falling stars converging into a great luminous tide, happening in turquoise cascades through an ancestral sanctuary; wide cinematic view with the creature large in the foreground; a wide sweeping crescent. revisions.reason: The two original-prompt outputs repeated an oversized white spirit dragon across 24 miracle scenes instead of keeping falling stars, healing petals, and protective canopies as the main subjects.
revisions.change: Clarify the original event subjects and subordinate distant scale animals; preserve all card IDs, order, grid, environments and palettes.
revisions.reviewNotes: Third output shows the intended 8 meteor-tide scenes, 8 healing-petal/root scenes, and 8 protective canopy scenes; small animals provide scale. No repeated oversized spirit dragon remains.
